analysis_method: edgeR::filterByExpr + edgeR::calcNormFactors(method='TMM') + limma::voom + limma::lmFit + contrasts.fit + eBayes(robust=TRUE)
input_contract: raw non-negative integer read counts; matched sample metadata; two selected groups with at least two samples each
output_contract: per-feature logFC, AveExpr, t, P.Value, BH-adjusted adj.P.Val, B, direction and AnalysisRun provenance
scope: project-specific RNA-seq plugin; historical S1/S2 and Exp006–Exp011 outputs were not changed
